Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Tender Terms and Conditions 1. Interested bidders must follow the instructions provided on the GeM (Government e-Marketplace) po rtal to participate in this e-tender.

2. Failure to submit the required documents or fulfill the conditions stipulated in the tender within the pr escribed timeframe will render the bid invalid. 3. A supply order will be issued by this office to the bidder whose tender is approved. 4. It is mandatory to submit an undertaking confirming acceptance of all the terms and conditions of the tender. 5. A self-attested copy of the PAN card and Income Tax Returns (ITR) for the years 2023-2024 and 2024- 2025 must be submitted. 6. Bidders must attach a self-attested copy of their GST registration certificate. 7. If the bidder is not the manufacturer, they must attach a letter from the original manufacturer authori zing them as an authorized dealer/distributor. 8. If the bidder is registered as a Micro, Small, or Medium Enterprise (MSME) under government norms, a copy of the valid certificate issued by the competent authority must be attached. 9. If the bidder or the manufacturer has previously supplied similar products/items to government or se mi-government offices/organizations, copies of such supply orders should be attached. 10. The bidder or the manufacturer must possess at least 3 years of experience in supplying goods/servic es for government-related work. 11. It is mandatory for the bidder to submit an affidavit on a non-judicial stamp paper of Rs. 500/-, declari ng that they have not been blacklisted by any government department. 12. While participating in the e-te ndering process, after submitting the tender, the bidder must deposit a sample of the materials to be suppl ied at the Ashti SFD (Social Forestry Division) office by 25/11/2026 and upload the acknowledgment receip t within the bid documents. 13. A certificate confirming the quality of the supplied material samples must be obtained from the Forest Department (Ashti SFD office) and submitted along with the bid. 14. The bidder must provide an annual turnover certificate issued by a Chartered Accountant (CA). The av erage total annual turnover for the years 2024-25 and 2025-26 must be ₹3 crore. Additionally, a Bank Solv ency Certificate from a nationalized bank for the amount of ₹3 crore is required. 15. The bidder must have an average total annual turnover of ₹1 crore for the two-year period of 2024-25 and 2025-26. 16. All certificates must be valid as of the date of the bid issuance. All documents to be attached with the t echnical and financial (price) bids must be in Marathi, Hindi, or English; documents in any other regional la nguage will not be accepted. 17. Bidders must deposit the samples at the designated office before the tender submission period conclu des. 18. The submitted material samples will not be returned. For the cancelled tender, the sample materials s ubmitted by the bidders and the sample inspection fees already paid shall remain valid. 19. Bidders must obtain a certificate from the office confirming the high quality of the submitted samples a nd include this certificate when submitting their tender. 20. This tender is reserved for vendors based in the State of Maharashtra. 21. If any defects arise in the supplied materials within 3 years, the bidder must ensure they are repaired as promptly as possible. 22. Bidders or manufacturers must provide copies of supply orders for the products in question, issued by government or semi-government offices/institutions during the current year. 23. Bidders are required to submit an affidavit on a Rs. 500/- stamp paper, declaring that all documents su bmitted with the tender are authentic. The affidavit must also state that if any submitted documents are fo

und to be false, the bidder will face legal action, and their tender will be cancelled at any stage. 24. It is mandatory to submit an undertaking confirming acceptance of all terms and conditions of the tend er. 25. Bidders are required to submit an annual average turnover certificate and a balance sheet. 26. It is mandatory to submit an affidavit—bearing the bid number and the bidder's signature—confirming acceptance of all terms and conditions of the tender. .
